mapper.select:
select * from bm_weigh_log log
and log.material_type = #{categoryType}
and log.material_id = #{materialId}
and log.material_batch_no like concat('%',#{materialBatchNo},'%')
and log.material_no like concat('%',#{materialNo},'%')
and log.weigh_type = #{weighType}
and (log.equipment_name like concat('%',#{equipmentInfo},'%') or log.equipment_code like concat('%',#{equipmentInfo},'%'))
and (log.product_name like concat('%',#{productInfo},'%') or log.product_merge_code like concat('%',#{productInfo},'%'))
and log.product_batch_no like concat('%',#{productBatchNo},'%')
and log.weigh_time between concat(#{startTime}, ' 00:00:00') and concat(#{endTime}, ' 23:59:59')
order by weigh_time desc
